verdict.rationale: Supabase supports local dev stacks (CLI init/start), branching for isolated preview environments separate from production, and self-hosting via Docker—all letting AI-native users test safely without touching prod data. Community evidence confirms branching/preview databases were built specifically to discourage direct prod edits, and CEO commentary corroborates this as an explicit design goal. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that AI agents specifically use these sandbox/branch environments (vs. production) by default, and clearer guardrails preventing MCP-connected agents from accidentally targeting prod.
